spans.s:
श्वःश्रेयस (सं)
adv. Happy, well.
sub.
Supreme Being; happiness.
a.
Happy, prosperous.

श्वक (इ, ङ) श्वंकते 1.
d. To go.

स्वग (इ) स्वंगति 1.
a. To go, to move.

श्व-गण (णः) 1.
m. A pack of dogs.

श्व-गणिक (कः) 1.
m. A hunter.
m. f.
(ई) Dog-feeder; one carried by
dogs.

श्वागणिक (कः) 1.
m. A hunter.
m. f.
(ई) A dog-keeper; one drawn
by dogs.

श्वच (इ, ङ) श्वचते 1.
d. To go.

श्वज श्वजते and (इ) श्वंजते 1.
d. Id.

स्व-ज (जः) 1.
m. A son; perspira-
tion. 1.
f. Daughter.
n. Blood.
a. Self born or produced.

श्वठ् श्वाठयति 10.
a. To finish; leave
unfinished; go; speak well or
ill. Also with (इ) श्वण्टयति.

श्व-दंष्ट्रा (ष्ट्रा) 1.
f. A dog's tooth; a
fruit,
Flacourtia.

श्वन् (श्वा) 5.
m. A dog; शुनी a bitch.

स्वन् स्वनति 1.
a. To sound. (क) स्वन-
यति 10.
a. To adorn. With
prep.
अव or वि to make a noise whilst
eating.

श्व-निश (शं-शा) 1.
n. f. Night on
which dogs bark.

श्व-पच (चः-चा) 1.
m. f. A dog feeder,
low man.

श्व-पद (दं) 1.
n. A dog's foot; a brand.

श्वा-पद (दः-दी-दं)
m. A beast of prey
in general.
a. Ferocious, savage.

श्व-पाक (कः) 1.
m. A man of a de-
graded and outcaste tribe.

श्व-फल (लः) 1.
m. The lime or
citron.

श्वभ्र (क) श्वभ्रयति 10.
a. To live in
misery or distress; to move; to
make a hole.

श्वभ्र (भ्रं) 1.
n. A hole, gap, chasm.

श्वर्त्त (क) श्वर्त्तयति 10.
a. To live in
misery or distress; to go.

ष्वर्त्त (क) ष्वर्त्तयति 10.
a. To go; to
be wretched.

स्वर्त्त (क) स्वर्त्तयति 10.
a. To be miser-
able or distressed.

श्व-वृत्ति (त्तिः) 2.
m. Service, low ser-
vitude.

स्व-वृत्ति (त्तिः) 2.
f. Own business or
means of living.

श्व-व्याघ्र (घ्रः) 1.
m. The hunting leopard or
chitā.

श्वशुर्य्य (र्य्यः) 1.
m. A brother-in-law,
husband's younger brother.

श्वस (ल) श्वसिति 2.
a. To breathe; to
[]
live. With
prep. आ, to revive,
encourage, console; with उत्,
to expand, to console; with निर
to expire, to sigh; with वि, to
trust.

श्वास (सः) 1.
m. Breath, breathing,
sighing; air, wind.

adv. To-morrow; a particle
implying auspiciousness.

श्वसन (नः) 1.
m. Air, wind; thorny
plant.
n. Breathing, breath,
sighing.

श्वसनेश्वर (रः) 1.
m. A tree,
Pentap-
tera Arjuna.

श्व-सुत (तः) 1.
m. A plant,
Conyza
lacera.

श्वस्तन (नः-नी-नं)
a. Future, what
will be to-morrow.

श्व-स्पृष्ट (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
a. Touched by a
dog, defiled.

श्वान (नः) 1.
m. A dog.
f. (ई) Bitch.

श्वाश्व (श्वः) 1.
m. Bhairava or
Shiva
in a terrific form.

श्वास-प्रश्वास-धारण (णं) 1.
n. Breath-
ing through the nostrils as a re-
ligious exercise.

श्वासा_रि (रिः) 2.
m. A plant, commonly
Bamanaithi.

ष्वद् (ङ, क) स्वदते 1.
d. and (क) स्वा-
दयति 10.
a. To taste; be pleas-
ing; cover.

ष्वप् (लि ञि) स्वपिति 2.
a. To sleep.

स्व (स्वः) 1.
m. A kinsman; soul; self.
a. Own.
n. Wealth, property.

स्व-कर्म्म-कृत् (त्) 5.
m. A workman
who has a business of his own.

स्व-कर्म्मन् (र्म्मा) 5.
m. Own act or
business.

स्व-कर्म्म-वश (शः-शा-शं)
a. Reaping
the fruit of one's own doings.

स्व-कर्म्म-स्थ (स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
a. Minding
one's own work.

स्वकीय (यः-या-यं)
a. Of one's own fa-
mily, own.

स्व-कृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Done by one's
self.

स्व-गत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Kept to one's
self; apart, aside.

स्वा_गत (तं) 1.
n. Welcome, salutation.
f. A kind of metre.

स्व-गृह (हः) 1.
m. A small bird,
Lo-
xia.

स्वच्छन्द-शक्ति (क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति)
a. Of un-
controlled power.

स्व-जातीय (यः-या-यं)
a. Of one's own
tribe.

स्वठ (क) स्वठयति 10.
a. To finish, or
the opposite.

स्व-तन्त्र (न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं)
a. Being one's
own master; of age; uncontrol-
led, independent, free.
adv. Of itself or one's self.

स्वत्र (त्रः) 1.
m. A blind man.
a. Self-
preserving.

स्व-त्व (त्वं) 1.
n. Self-existence; inde-
pendence; own property.

स्वत्व-निवृत्ति (त्तिः) 2.
f. Loss of title
to property.

स्वत्व-व्यभिचारित्व (त्वं) 1.
n. Uncer-
tainty of ownership.

स्वत्व-हानि (निः) 2.
f. Loss of title to
property.

स्वत्वा_भाव (वः) 1.
m. Absence of pro-
prietary right.

स्वत्वा_स्पद (दं) 1.
n. Ground of pro-
prietary right.

स्वद (ङ) स्वदते 1.
d. To taste; be sweet.

स्वाद (ङ) स्वादते 1.
d. To taste. (कि)
स्वादति, स्वादयति 1. 10.
a. To be
pleasing. 10.
a. To cover.

स्वदित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Eaten.
n. Ques-
tion put to the manes, whether
they are satisfied.

स्व-दृश् (क्)
a. Viewing self (as ano-
ther); seeing for one's self.

स्वदेश-परिधि (धिः) 2.
f. Circumfer-
ence of a meridian.

स्वदेश-मध्य-परिधि (धिः) 2.
f. Circum-
ference of the equator.

adv. Exclamation when offer-
ing to the manes; the food offer-
ed. 1.
f. Personification of
Māyā;
Durgā; illusion; a nymph.

स्वधा-भुज् (क्) 5.
m. Deified ancestor, a deity.

स्वधिति-हेतिक (कः) 1.
m. A soldier
armed with an axe.

स्वनासा_ग्र-निरीक्षण (णः-णा-णं)
a. Look-
ing at the tip of one's nose.

स्वनित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Sounded.
n.
Noise of thunder.

स्वप्न (प्नः) 1.
m. Idem; dreaming; a
dream.

स्वप्न-विचारिन् (री) 5.
m. An inter-
preter of dreams.

स्वप्ना_वस्था (स्था) 1.
f. State of dream-
ing; life viewed as such.

स्व-भाजन (नं) 1.
n. Civility, welcome
or adieu.

स्व-भाव (वः) 1.
m. Nature; natural
state or disposition; intention.

स्वभावो_क्ति (क्तिः) 2.
f. Free declara-
tion; delineation of character.

स्वयंवर (रं) 1.
n. Free choice of a
husband. 1.
f. A girl choosing
her own husband.

स्वयन्दत्त (त्तः) 1.
m. A child who has
given himself to adoptive parents.

adv. Self; of or by one's self,
spontaneously, naturally.

स्वय-मुक्ति (क्तिः) 2.
f. Free declara-
tion; deposition.

स्वय-म्प्रभ (भः) 1.
m. A
Jina of the future era.

स्वायम्भुव (वः-वी-वं)
a. Of the self-
born.
m. Swayambhu's son.

स्व-योनि (निः-निः-नि)
a. Of kin.
f.
A sister.

स्वर् (क) स्वरयति 10.
a. To blame; to sound.

ind. Heaven, sky; splendour;
division of the universe.

स्वर (रः) 1.
m. Sound; accent; vow-
el; musical note; snoring.

स्वर-भङ्ग (ङ्गः) 1.
m. Fluttering of
the voice through agitation, &c.

स्वर-भङ्गिन् (ङ्गी) 5.
m. A kind of bird.

स्वर-मण्डलिका (का) 1.
f. A kind of
stringed musical instrument.

स्व-रस (सः) 1.
m. Peculiar juice; ex-
tracted juice, oil, &c. of peculiar
flavour; peculiar taste or ele-
gance.

स्वरांश (शः) 1.
m. A half or quarter tone.

स्व-राज् (ट्) 5.
m. Brahmā; a metre
peculiar to the
Vedas.

स्वरित (तः) 1.
m. The circumflex
accent.
a. Accented; articulat-
ed; pitched as a note.

स्वरु (रुः) 2.
m. Indra's thunderbolt;
an arrow; a sacrifice; shavings of
the sacrificial post; sunshine; a
scorpion.

स्व-रूप (पं) 1.
n. Natural state or
condition; nature; natural con-
clusion; kind, sort.
a. Similar
in character; beautiful; wise.

स्वरूप-गत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Having the
same form or object.

स्वरूपता (ता) 1.
f. Identity, like-
ness; beauty; natural state.

स्वरेणु (णुः) 2.
f. One of the wives of
the sun.

स्वर्ग-गत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Gone to hea-
ven.

स्व-र्गङ्गा (ङ्गा) 1.
f. The Ganges of heaven.

स्व-र्गति (तिः)
f. 2. Going to heaven; death.

स्वर्ग-पर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Desirous of hea-
ven.

स्वर्ग-लोकेश (शः) 1.
m. The body; the
enjoyer of
Indra's heaven.

स्वर्ग-वधू (धूः) 3.
f. A celestial courte-
zan.

स्वर्गा_पवर्ग-काम (मः-मा-मं)
a. Desirous
of heavenly bliss.

स्वर्गिन् (र्गी) 5.
m. A god, a celestial
being; a deceased man.

स्वर्गि-वधू (धूः) 3.
f. A nymph of pa-
radise.

स्वर्गौ_कस् (काः) 5.
m. A god, a deity.

स्वर्ग्य (र्ग्यः-र्ग्या-र्ग्यं)
a. Heavenly; con-
ferring heaven.

स्वर्ण-क्षीरी (री) 3.
f. A medicinal
kind of moon-plant.

स्वर्ण-चूड (डः) 1.
m. The blue jay; a
cock.

स्व-र्णदी (दी) 3.
f. The Ganges of heaven.

स्वर्ण-द्रु (द्रुः) 2.
m. A tree with yel-
low blossoms.

स्वर्ण-पद्मा (द्मा) 1.
f. The Ganges of
heaven.

स्वर्ण-पुष्प (ष्पः-ष्पी) 1.
m. f. The
Cassia
fistula. m. The

.
f.
Gum arabic tree.
f. (ई) Medici-
nal moon-plant.

स्वर्ण-वल्कल (लः) 1.
m. A plant,
Big-
nonia Indica.

स्वर्ण-विन्दु (न्दुः) 2.
m. Viṣṇu; speck of gold.

स्वर्ण-सेफालिका (का) 1.
f. A tree,
Cas-
sia fistula.

स्वर्द्द (ङ) स्वर्द्दते 1.
d. To taste; to be
pleasing.

स्व-र्नदी (दी) 3.
f. The Ganges of heaven.

स्व-र्वैद्य (द्यः) 1.
m. A physician of
heaven,
i. e. either of the sons
of the sun by
Aswini.

स्वल्प (ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं)
a. Very small, very few.

स्वाल्प (ल्पः-ल्पी-ल्पं)
a. Little, few.
n.
Littleness, paucity.

स्वल्प-केशिन् (शी) 5.
m. Root of sweet flag.

स्व-वासिनी (नी) 3.
f. A woman at her
father's.

interj. (Be it well,) a particle
of benediction, approbation, or
auspiciousness.

स्वस्तिक (कः-कं) 1.
m. n. A temple with
a portico in front.
n. Lucky ob-
ject; meeting of four roads; a
palace with a portico on three
sides; a mystical mark; a cake;
a libertine.

स्वस्ति-मुख (खः) 1.
m. A letter, a note;
a
Brāhman; a panegyrist.

स्वस्ति-वाचन (नं) 1.
n. A preparatory
rite; scattering rice and invok-
ing the gods to be propitious.

स्वस्त्ययन (नः-नी-नं)
a. Auspicious.
n.
Deprecation of evil; benediction.

स्वस्थ (स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
a. Confident, inde-
pendent; in health.

स्व-स्रीय (यः) 1.
m. A sister's son. 1.
f. Sister's daughter.

स्व-हितैषिन् (षी-षिणी-षि)
a. Seeking
one's own good.

स्वा_कार (रः-रा-रं)
a. Having one's
own form. Also स्वाकृति, स्वाकृत्.

स्वाति (तिः-ती) 2. 3.
f. One of the
wives of the sun;
Arcturus; a
sword.

स्वात्म-न्नति (तिः-तिः-ति)
a. Deriving
pleasure from self (God).

स्वादु (दुः-दुः-द्वी-दु)
a. Sweet, agree-
able; handsome.
m. Sweetness;
treacle; medicinal root.
f. (द्वी or
दु) A grape.

स्वादु-कण्टक (कः) 1.
m. A plant,
Fla-
courtia sapida; a creeper.

स्वादु-गन्धा (न्धा) 1.
f. A creeper,
Con-
volvulus paniculatus.

स्वादु-फल (लं) 1.
n. The fruit of the
jujube. 1.
f. The tree.

स्वादु-मज्जन् (ज्जा) 5.
m. A sort of tree.

स्वादु-रसा (सा) 1.
f. A medicinal root,
[]
Kākoli; the hog plum; vinous
liquor; a grape.

स्वादु-शुद्ध (द्धं) 1.
n. Rock or river salt.

स्वा_धिकार (रः) 1.
m. Own office or station.

स्वाधीन-पतिका (का) 1.
f. An inde-
pendent woman.

स्वा_ध्याय (यः) 1.
m. Muttering of
prayers;
Vedas; study of them.

स्वा_ध्यायवत् (वान्) 5.
m. A student
of the
Vedas.

स्वा_ध्यायिन् (यी) 5.
m. Idem; a trades-
man.

स्वान्त (न्तं) 1.
n. The mind; a ca-
vern.
a. Sounded.

स्वामिन् (मी) 5.
m. A master, a hus-
band; a proprietor, king; a god;
Kārtikeya; Shiva.

स्वामि-मूल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Depending
on the master.

स्वामि-सद्भाव (वः) 1.
m. Existence or
kindness of a master.

स्वामि-सेवा (वा) 1.
f. Attention to a
master.

स्वाराज्य (ज्यं) 1.
n. Final bliss;
In-
dra's heaven.

स्वा_र्थ (र्थं) 1.
n. Property; object;
a pleonasm.
a. Pleonastic.

स्वार्थ-कुशल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Knowing
one's own design or interest.

स्वार्थ-सिद्धि (द्धिः) 2.
f. Attainment of
one's end; success.

स्वा_र्थिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Having its
own meaning or object.

स्वास्थ्य (स्थ्यं) 1.
n. Health; content-
ment; fortitude.

adv. Exclamation on offering
to the gods.
f. Wife of fire, god-
dess of the
Buddhists.
